summary:
Complete 4-slide web presentation for Blockbuster Digital CIS.

**Slide 1 — Company Profile**: Blockbuster Video company details, sector, core activity (physical rentals, digital scanning, 4K streaming), and stakeholder needs. Presenter: Maria Fernanda Huertas Montes.

**Slide 2 — Problem Statement & Requirements Refinement**: Business issues alert card (inventory delays, manual tape management, late fee friction) plus three requirements cards (Bottleneck, Workflow, CIS Architecture). Presenter: Juan Camilo Valencia Rey.

**Slide 3 — Proposed Solution & Workflow**: Two-column layout with key CIS capabilities (Automates, Manages, Stores, Eliminates Bottlenecks) on the left and a fully replicated SVG flowchart of the VIP Rental Payment Flow on the right — matching the exact node shapes, labels, and color scheme from the reference image. Interactive zoom controls and hover tooltips. Presenter: Jhoan Steven Murillo Garcia.

**Slide 4 — Expected Results & Impact**: Three impact cards (Speeds Up, Improves, Secures), closing quote banner, and development team footer. Presenter: Valeria Becerra Giraldo.

Features:
- Dark navy (#0A0E1A) background with vibrant yellow (#FFD100) accents
- CRT scanline overlay for retro-tech aesthetic
- Slide navigation (prev/next buttons, dot indicators, keyboard arrows)
- Smooth slide transitions with directional animation
- Hover-glow effects on flowchart nodes with tooltips
- Flowchart zoom in/out/reset controls
- Fully responsive layout with Tailwind CSS
